Messages.Author: Rehlow
Messages.Body:
I drafted Redline and actually got to play it. I don't have the card
here, but the text is pretty close to:

Out-of-Turn Master
Only playable when a vampire is burned by a Blood Hunt. The vampire is
not burned, put this card on that vampire. Take control of that
vampire. The vampire is now independent, gets a press once per combat
against Camarilla vamps, and has a +1 stealth rush at Camarilla vamps.
Burn this card and this vampire if it changes sects.

Anyone with actual card text, feel free to post corrections.

Like I said above I got to play it one game. When my predator
amarathaned my prey's vamp, my prey and I successfully called a Blood
Hunt. My prey wanted that vamp to pay (he just got a full Cooler and
Meat Hook from the diablerie). Then I played Redline, and it was a
nice shift in table balance, but still was not enough to get me any
VPs that round.

I rarely see vamps burned in Blood Hunts locally, and the ones that
are aren't really worth taking. Maybe you can trick someone into
diablerizing by telling them you'll make sure the vamp is still around
after the Blood Hunt. Sneaky!

Later,
~Rehlow
